# Kinetic Business Intelligence (Kinetic BI)

> Kinetic BI builds applied-AI platforms and the data engineering underneath them, for healthcare, global health, and enterprise. 200+ projects shipped since 2016 across four continents; now building from the US.

Kinetic BI (kineticsbi.com) is a data and AI engineering firm. We design and operate applied/agentic AI systems and the data platforms, pipelines, and integrations they depend on — with quality enforced at ingestion and data kept with its owner. Founded 2016. Offices in Wilmington, DE and Dallas, TX. Contact: info@kineticsbi.com.

## What we do
- Applied & Agentic AI — agents, RAG systems, ontologies, evaluations, guardrails
- AI Platforms — data, retrieval, guardrails, and interfaces as one system
- Data Platforms — warehouses and repositories with end-to-end lineage
- ETL / ELT Pipelines — resilient pipelines that survive schema drift
- BI & Visualization — dashboards for stakeholder decision-making
- Systems Integration — DHIS2, FHIR, HL7, and legacy API connectivity

## Proof points
- Africa CDC Central Data Repository — unified disease surveillance across 55 member states on DHIS2, over unreliable networks
- UNHCR — data warehouse and ELT pipeline with a BI visualization layer across 84 country operations
- Task Force for Global Health — 5× analyst output on a shared AI platform
- VITAL WorkLife — HIPAA-compliant case management that reduced support cost
- Compliance posture: SOC 2, HIPAA-ready, GDPR
